h1: Tanyong Hotel Narathiwat — a long-running central hotel that is still many travellers' first pick in town
intro: Ask anyone who has been to Narathiwat where to stay in town and the name that comes up most is Tanyong Hotel · A 3-star hotel on Sophapisai Road that has been open since 1977 and was renovated in 2024 · The draw is not luxury but a location with a 7-Eleven and Cafe Amazon right across the street, staff that reviews repeatedly call warm and helpful, and free on-site parking · TripAdvisor ranks it the #1 hotel in Narathiwat · From approx ฿900/night.

body.html: Tanyong Hotel has been open since 1977, making it one of the longest-running hotels in Narathiwat town · It sits on Sophapisai Road in the Bang Nak area, right in the centre of town, about 10 minutes by car from Narathiwat Airport · With 84 rooms it is fairly large for a small-town hotel, and a 2024 renovation has freshened up parts of it compared with the older photos many people remember.

Rooms run from Deluxe and Deluxe Twin up through Junior King to Family rooms · Most are air-conditioned with a TV, a fridge and an en-suite bathroom with hot water · The thing guests mention most is that rooms are larger than expected and the beds are comfortable · Some Junior King and Deluxe Twin rooms have a balcony with a city view · The trade-off is the hotel's age — rooms that have not yet been renovated show some wear, with dated furniture and decor, so anyone who wants a crisp, modern room should ask for a renovated one when booking.
"The staff went far above and beyond, so friendly and helpful · The room was large and clean, and the location could not be easier — there is a 7-Eleven and a Cafe Amazon right across the road."

The most consistent praise in reviews is for the staff · Guests say again and again that the team is warm, smiling and genuinely willing to help, from arranging cars and tours to small things in the room · In a town that still sees few foreign tourists, that kind of welcoming host is what brings people back · The one limitation is that some staff speak only limited English, though their eagerness to help makes up for a lot.

Inside the hotel there is a restaurant, karaoke, a massage service and free on-site parking · Breakfast is where opinions split — some guests find it fine and say staff happily adjust dishes on request, while others grumble that the choice is limited, with only white toast for bread, weak coffee and small portions · The upside is you do not have to rely on the hotel breakfast, as there is a Cafe Amazon and local eateries within walking distance all around.

Honestly, Tanyong Hotel is not a crisp, brand-new property · Some reviews mention the building's age, hot water that is weak at times, few power outlets and dated decor · But in the context of Narathiwat town, where proper hotel options are limited, it remains a sensible pick for anyone who wants a central location, spacious rooms, free parking and warm service at an affordable price · A score of 7.9 from 20 Trip.com reviews and 7.6 on Booking.com reflects exactly that — nothing flashy, but it does its job well.

A tip from reading the reviews: ask for a renovated room, and if you can get a Junior King or a Deluxe Twin with a city-view balcony you will be more comfortable · Standard rates sit around ฿900–฿1,300/night depending on room type and season · Self-drivers have it easy thanks to the free parking, and the location puts convenience stores, cafes and restaurants within a short walk.

honestSummary: Tanyong Hotel sells a central location, spacious rooms, free parking and warm service at an affordable price — a top pick for anyone who wants to stay in the centre of Narathiwat within walking distance of convenience stores and cafes · The trade-offs are an ageing building, some rooms that still feel old, and an ordinary breakfast.
honestChecks: If you want a crisp, modern room with contemporary design — the hotel has been open since 1977 and some rooms are not yet renovated → ask for a 2024-renovated room when booking, or consider a newer boutique hotel in town.

If you expect a varied breakfast — the menu is fairly limited, with ordinary coffee and bread → there is a Cafe Amazon and local eateries within walking distance, so you do not have to rely on the hotel breakfast.
If you need a lot of English to communicate — some staff speak only limited English → keep a translation app handy, though the team's willingness to help makes up for a lot.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Tanyong Hotel Narathiwat

faq.q: Where is Tanyong Hotel in Narathiwat and what is nearby?
faq.a: Tanyong Hotel is at 16/1 Sophapisai Road, Bang Nak, in central Narathiwat · There is a 7-Eleven and Cafe Amazon right across the street within walking distance · Narathat Beach and the Central Mosque are about 6–7 minutes by car · Narathiwat Airport (NAW) is around 10 minutes by car.

faq.q: How much does Tanyong Hotel cost and what rooms are available?
faq.a: Rates start from about ฿900/night for a Deluxe room · Deluxe Twin and Junior King rooms run roughly ฿1,000–฿1,200, and the Family room around ฿1,400 · Prices vary by season and room type, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Is the hotel old, and what are the rooms like?
faq.a: The hotel has been open since 1977 so it is on the older side, but it was renovated in 2024, which has freshened parts of it up · Many guests praise the rooms as large with comfortable beds · Rooms that have not been renovated show some wear and dated decor, so ask for a renovated room when booking.

faq.q: Who is Tanyong Hotel best for?
faq.a: It suits anyone who wants to stay in central Narathiwat, within walking distance of convenience stores and cafes, at an affordable price · Good for solo travellers, families and self-drivers thanks to free parking · It is about convenience and warm service rather than new-build luxury.

faq.q: Does Tanyong Hotel have parking and breakfast?
faq.a: Yes — there is free on-site parking, handy for self-drivers · Breakfast is available (included in some packages) but the choice is fairly limited, with some reviews grumbling about the coffee and bread · There is a Cafe Amazon and local eateries within walking distance around the hotel.

faq.q: What should I know before booking Tanyong Hotel?
faq.a: Know that this is a long-running hotel that leans on location and service rather than being new or luxurious · Some rooms have weak hot water and few power outlets · Some staff speak only limited English but are very helpful · Ask for a renovated room and book ahead during festivals for a better room.
